title: Optimization of supercritical fluid extraction of valuable compounds from Lagerstroemia speciosa leaves for in vitro antidiabetic and antioxidant activity
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00395D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kiran Khandare, Saswata Goswami
Optimized supercritical CO2 extraction (SFE) conditions for L. speciosa leaves were 29.59 MPa, 89.50 °C and 53.85 min, yielding high TPC. The extract exhibited potent antidiabetic and antioxidant activity.
